description: PF7 backward from page 2 to page 1: the READPREV DFHRESP(ENDFILE) arm at app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:668-674, and the only case in this folder that reaches the MOVE at :369. TRACE. EIBCALEN is 194, so :110 falls to the ELSE and :114 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA overwrites the whole area - including the 34-byte CDEMO-CU00-INFO extension and therefore the SET NEXT-PAGE-NO of :102, which is why the caller's 'Y' survives into the response. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1, so :115 takes the re-entry branch (gate G38): :117 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR0AO does NOT run, :121 RECEIVEs the page-2 image declared below, and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :122-137 is reached at all. PF7 matches the third arm at :128-129, so PROCESS-PF7-KEY runs: :239-242 takes CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST (ZUSER001, row 1 of page 2) as the RIDFLD, :245 SETs NEXT-PAGE-YES unconditionally, :246 moves -1 into USRIDINL, and :248 finds the count 2 greater than 1 so PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD is performed rather than the already-at-the-top ELSE of :250-254 that case08 pins. STARTBR at :338 positions on ZUSER001 and reports NORMAL; :342's two-operand abbreviated relation holds for PF7, so the READPREV at :343 discards the anchor; :346-350 then INITIALIZE-USER-DATA blanks all ten rows - USRIDnn, FNAMEnn, LNAMEnn and UTYPEnn only, never the SELnnnn cells, which have no clearing statement anywhere in the program; :352 seeds WS-IDX at 10 and the loop at :354-360 reads downward, USER0005 into row 10 through to ADMIN001 into row 1, stopping with WS-IDX at 0. POPULATE-USER-DATA also moves SEC-USR-ID into CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST at index 1 (:389) and into CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST at index 10 (:435), which is why the extension comes back ADMIN001 / USER0005 - written in descending index order, so the 'first' field is assigned last. The look-behind READPREV at :363 finds nothing below ADMIN001 and reports ENDFILE: :669's bare CONTINUE is a no-op and the statements after it DO run, so :670 sets end of file, :671 paints 'You have reached the top of the page...', :673 moves -1 into USRIDINL and :674 sends. Note 'top' here against the 'bottom' of READNEXT's :637 - the two arms are otherwise identical and swapping the literals would pass every other assertion in this folder. No error flag is raised by an end of file, so :364 is still reached: NEXT-PAGE-YES holds because of :245, :365's first conjunct now fails because end of file has just been set, and the ELSE at :369 moves 1 into the count - the start of the file has been reached, so this is page 1 by definition however the count had drifted. :374 ENDBRs, :376 writes that 1 into PAGENUMI and :377 sends again. There are therefore TWO sends on this path and the response carries the second: WS-MESSAGE is not cleared between them, so the final image shows page 00000001 under the end-of-file message. USRIDINO passes through as spaces because the only MOVE SPACE TO USRIDINO sites are :231 and :328, both on the forward path. WHAT THE RECEIVED IMAGE PROVES. mapFields carries a coherent page-2 screen - ZUSER001..ZUSER010 with PAGENUMI 00000002 - and every one of those values is absent from the response, which is the assertion: the backward fill REPLACED the received rows rather than merging with them, and :376 overwrote the received count. The two items that do travel are the ones nothing on this path rewrites, USRIDINI and the ten blank SELnnnn cells. Together with the AID and the 194-byte communication area, that image is the whole of the conversation state - it arrives in the payload and leaves in the payload, with no HttpSession, no @SessionAttributes and no cache anywhere in the path (gate G37, rule R6), and the response is a pure function of it. NO WRITE, NO CHANGE. COUSR00C opens USRSEC for browse only, so expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion that nothing was written rather than an absence of interest, and all 25 rows are pinned unchanged - both field by field and as whole 80-byte images - with expectedDatasets adding the count no row expectation can make: USRSEC still holds exactly 25 rows at its 80-byte width, which is what 'the browse changed nothing' means (gates G19, G21). expectedReturnCode is 0, as it is for all twenty cases: the program contains no MOVE ... TO RETURN-CODE and no CALL 'CEE3ABD', and every path ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CU00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) of :141-144. expectedMessages is empty because this program emits no line on any channel this case reaches: the three DISPLAY 'RESP:' ... 'REAS:' sites at :608, :642 and :676 are the WHEN OTHER arms of the three browse verbs, and the ENDFILE arm taken here is not one of them. The message text is asserted where it is observable, as the 78-byte ERRMSGO of the transmission - MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO at :526 narrows X(80) to X(78) by truncating on the right - and never duplicated into expectedMessages, which the case model reserves for lines a program emits. PROVENANCE (practice B12, risk R-A): every expected value here was DERIVED BY STRUCTURED READING of the COBOL and its copybooks and was NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy program - executing it is impossible in this environment, which has no z/OS or CICS runtime, whose COBOL compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, and which is missing the IBM-supplied DFHAID and DFHBMSCA. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-of-zero gate are all preserved. The derivation rests on app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:98-144, :237-255, :336-379, :384-441, :446-501, :522-544 and :653-682; app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44, whose spans sum to 160, plus the six of :67-75 that make 194; app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23, whose 8+20+20+8+1 = 57 plus the NAMED SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) make 80; app/cpy-bms/COUSR00.CPY, where 01 COUSR0AO REDEFINES COUSR0AI at :373 is what makes a received item and its sent counterpart the same storage, and where ERRMSGI and ERRMSGO are both PIC X(78) at :372 and :728; app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy for the two PIC X(40) titles; and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl, whose :35-44 supply the seed and whose :48 DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) and :64-66 IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER KEYS(8,0) RECORDSIZE(80,80) fix that width independently. app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:88-99 defines FILE(USRSEC) with ADD, BROWSE, DELETE, READ and UPDATE; this program uses browse alone. SEED: USRSEC has no ASCII fixture - app/data/ASCII holds nine and none of them is a security-user file - so its rows are always inline, and no tenth fixture is introduced. Rows 1-10 are VERBATIM in-stream records of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 at their in-stream width of exactly 57 characters; rows 11-25 are the fifteen SYNTHESIZED ZUSER extensions this folder's 25-row cases share, which is what makes a three-page file and therefore a page-2 anchor possible at all. No row is pre-padded: the 23-byte shortfall is the absent SEC-USR-FILLER, and it is carried to 80 once, at seed time, by the single USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation declared below, whose sole owner is ParityCase.DatasetNormalisation.normaliseSeedRow, which ParityHarness calls. SEC-USR-PWD stays the plaintext eight-character literal the legacy design stores and compares at app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl (practice B6) - hashing, masking or omitting it would change what this contract asserts. CONVENTIONS, all inherited from case01 (practice B8, explicit over implicit): jobParameters is OMITTED rather than declared empty, because COUSR00C is not a batch job and the case model refuses a job parameter for any unitKind but BATCH_JOB - the conversation scalars travel as screenRequest.eibcalen, screenRequest.aid and screenRequest.commarea['CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT'] instead; the code page is named US-ASCII explicitly and never defaulted; the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:34, the source's own version stamp at :694 rather than an invented instant, because POPULATE-HEADER-INFO calls FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at :564 on every send and an unpinned header would make this case irreproducible (practice B7); and USRSEC is addressed by its binding key throughout, never by a dataset name (gate G46). Page size ten is BEHAVIOUR, not configuration (gate G39): it is hard-coded at :293, :300, :347 and :352 and by 02 USER-REC OCCURS 10 TIMES at :57, and it appears nowhere in this file as a tunable. No attribute or colour item is declared, because this program moves none: it does not COPY CSSETATY - AAP 0.2.3 gives that copybook one consumer, COACTUPC - it validates no individual screen field, and ERRMSG is STATICALLY COLOR=RED, ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) in app/bms/COUSR00.bms, so inventing a runtime DFHRED move or a '*' marker here would be a new behaviour (practice B5). RULE R1: the plan mandates the class name UserMenuController, but the Function header at app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:5 reads 'List all users from USRSEC file', app/bms/COUSR00.bms paints 'List Users' at POS=(4,35), and README.md records CU00 the same way; the name comes from the plan and the behaviour from the source. SCENARIO OWNERSHIP, recorded rather than resolved silently (practice B4). This slot pins the READPREV ENDFILE arm because it is the only case that does: within this folder STARTBR's three arms are pinned by case02, case04 and case19, READNEXT's by case02, case03, case18 and case10, and READPREV's NORMAL and WHEN OTHER by case07 and case17, which leaves ENDFILE here (gate G47). The AID EVALUATE's WHEN OTHER arm at :132-136, with CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY from app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy, is already pinned by case12 through an unhandled PF9, so repurposing this slot to a second unhandled key would have duplicated that arm and left READPREV's ENDFILE unpinned, with no free slot to move it to because gate G15 fixes the budget at exactly twenty per program. DECLARED GAPS the folder carries, covered by the user-package unit tests under gates G49 and G50 for the same budget reason: the lower-case 'd' twin at :201 - 'U', 'u' and 'D' are pinned by case13, case15 and case14 - and the blank-anchor derivation at :239-240, since all four PF7 cases declare a real CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST rather than the spaces that would move LOW-VALUES into the RIDFLD. The dead WS-USER-DATA array at :56-64 is left unmodelled, as no paragraph references it.
